project.name: NAM Protocol Engine
project.goal: Automate regulatory compliance and 3Rs justification for non-animal testing methods (OECD Test Guidelines).
project.tech_stack: Python 3.12, uv, pytest, Pydantic v2, Gradio UI, BM25 text retrieval

architecture.module: Pydantic models for structured regulatory protocols and citations.
Rules-based protocol matcher for OECD NAM alternatives.
Tiered strategy planner and quantitative decision models (PIF/MPE, DPRA peptide depletion).
Gradio frontend UI containing Strategy, Search, and Decision Calculators.

integrated_protocols.protocol: OECD TG 432: In vitro 3T3 NRU phototoxicity
OECD TG 437: BCOP corneal opacity and permeability
OECD TG 442C: In chemico skin sensitisation / DPRA
OECD TG 492: RhCE reconstructed cornea-like epithelium
OECD TG 497: Defined Approaches for skin sensitisation

milestone_state.status: OECD TG 442C integration complete and committed to main.
milestone_state.verification: UI manual validation passed (45/35 Standard, 10/0 Fallback). Automated suite passed (48/48 tests).

active_task.objective: Overhaul visual heuristics and regex patterns in src/extractor.py. Prevent inconsistent formatting (e.g., generic "Acceptance criteria" or "Test report" headers) from over-segmenting guideline chunks and poisoning the BM25 search index.
